item.title: Version 1.5.76
item.description:
✨ v1.5.76 Update

  • Follow-up Inline AI chats now retain the originally selected text.
  • Long Inline AI conversations summarize older messages while keeping the original text, full saved history, and recent exchanges available.
  • Direct typing results are saved in chat history with the source text and prompt, so you can reopen them and continue the conversation.
  • Improved Markdown tables, code blocks, quotes, and dividers, with readable quote colors in light and dark modes.
  • Moved previous chats into the chat title menu and added a compact preview of the selected text.
